description: Lists persisted pipeline recommendations for the authenticated business without generating, editing, approving, rejecting, or executing them. Use to review pipeline recommendations in the connected business. Returns filters, recommendations, summary, scope, draft_history.

action_type.description: Optional exact pipeline recommendation action type.

include_draft_history.description: When true, recommendation_id is required and bounded draft edit history is returned.

name: pipeline-recommendations

draft_history.description: Draft history metadata; empty collections retain their existing JSON array representation.

filters.description: Filters metadata; empty collections retain their existing JSON array representation.

recommendations.description: Bounded recommendations records returned by this tool.

scope.description: Authorization scope of this result; data remains restricted to the connected business.

summary.description: Summary metadata; empty collections retain their existing JSON array representation.

title: Pipeline Recommendations Tool
